name: prism-rules-lane-divergence
title: Repository prism rules never reach the sd-review lane
description: The sd-review local provider builds its own prism command and omits --rules, --exclude, and --fail-on, so .prism/rules.json applies only in the shell review lane. Every repository-owned prism rule is silently inert under sd-review, which is the lane sd-ship Stage 2 uses. Decide between documenting the divergence locally and proposing an upstream fix to the built-in prism adapter.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Observed on PR #158 (2026-08-06): prism reported the generated _example scaffold rows that .prism/rules.json's trellis-scaffold-convention rule (added by PR #156 to prevent exactly that) forbids reporting. Note that scripts/sd-ai-command-pack-review-local.py is installed from the sd-ai-command-pack (.sd-ai-command-pack/manifest.json) and is provenance-tracked and undrifted, so changing the built-in prism adapter is upstream work; .prism/rules.json is install: if-not-exists and therefore repo-owned. Fourth instance of the vendored-artifact pattern, alongside 08-06-watch-coordinator-infra-classification, 08-06-finalization-ordering-trap, and 08-06-work-loop-shipped-sha-after-branch-delete. Sequencing: eight active tasks edit .trellis/spec/backend/quality-guidelines.md. `order` 30 within the P2 band encodes the intended landing sequence (review lane cause; must land before the rebuttal disposition). Tasks with no `order` sort as 0 and therefore run before this cluster, which is intended: they do not contend for this file.
